source: Curiosity MSL RAD (Radiation Assessment Detector) surface measurement
caveat: Gale Crater MSL RAD surface measurement used as Jezero surface proxy (GCR dominated). Values confirmed with Zeitlin et al. (Science 2013) and Hassler et al.

limits.note: NASA Standard 3001 astronaut operational radiation exposure limits

spe_scenario.description: Coronal Mass Ejection shock arrival on Mars; high solar energetic proton flux requiring abort to Hab or regolith storm shelter.
